title: ROCAM CR1030DAB DAB+/FM Radio — Crank, Solar, 12000 mAh, Bluetooth
short_description: ROCAM CR1030DAB: DAB+/FM radio with 80 presets, a 12000 mAh battery, hand crank, solar panel and Bluetooth — for home and on the go.
long_description: According to Amazon, the ROCAM CR1030DAB is a DAB+/FM digital radio with 80 presets (40 DAB+ and 40 FM) and 57 mm speakers. It has a 12000 mAh battery and can be charged via a solar panel (8500 mm²), a hand crank (650 mA) and USB-C according to Amazon. It also offers Bluetooth and a USB-C port. According to the item description it also includes a flashlight, an SOS function and IPX6 protection. The radio measures 12 x 17.2 x 7.3 cm, weighs 700 g and comes in green. According to Amazon the box contains an owner's manual, a portable belt, the radio and a USB-C cable. Before buying, please check the manufacturer's exact details on the Amazon product page, especially on charging times and runtime.
features: 12000 mAh battery, charging via solar, crank and USB-C (according to Amazon)
According to the item description with flashlight, SOS function and IPX6
buying_angle: Handy for anyone looking for a radio that can also run without a power outlet via battery, solar panel or crank, for example at home, in the garden or on the go.
